purpose: Immutable contextual Outcome disposition pinned to one exact Actual realization MaterialState.

columns.name: actual_realization_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Exact Actual realization MaterialState this disposition describes.
columns.value_contract: Existing Actual realization state that was current when accepted.

columns.name: disposition_code
columns.meaning: Contextual Outcome disposition code; not a universal Outcome enum.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed lower-case contextual code up to 120 characters matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]*$.

foreign_keys.name: fk_outcome_disposition_state_state_address
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Bind disposition payload to the shared MaterialState address.

foreign_keys.name: fk_outcome_disposition_state_outcome_ref_outcome
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Each disposition state belongs to one stable Outcome.

foreign_keys.name: fk_outcome_disposition_state_actual_realization
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Pin Outcome meaning to one exact accepted Actual realization state.

check_constraints.name: ck_outcome_disposition_state_code
check_constraints.expression_contract: disposition_code=btrim(disposition_code) AND disposition_code<>'' AND char_length(disposition_code)<=120 AND disposition_code ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:-]*$'
check_constraints.reason: Keep disposition contextual and bounded without defining a universal taxonomy.

indexes.name: ix_outcome_disposition_state_actual_realization
indexes.reason: Trace dispositions to exact Actual realization states.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Each accepted Outcome creation/correction appends one immutable disposition state.
state_history.current_binding: Current state is selected through scoped_current_material_state for outcome.disposition.
state_history.chronology: Currentness is explicit; insertion order is not authority.
state_history.immutability_policy: Historical disposition rows are never rewritten.

obligations: Outcome state is pinned to exact Actual state
